about: When a whole file is sent, the exact locked top at its start and the exact locked bottom at its end are cut off, both or neither (V202-34). Read by the Go test on problems.StripLocked and by the Vitest test on the editor's stripLocked, so the two cannot drift. top and bottom are the locked parts as stored.

cases.name: whole file
cases.input:
import sys
def f(n):
    return n
print(f(1))

cases.name: bottom has no newline at its end
cases.input:
import sys
def f(n):
    return n
print(f(1))

cases.name: stored parts have no final newline
a typed top alone is kept
a typed bottom alone is kept
a near miss top keeps everything
cases.input:
import os
def f(n):
    return n
print(f(1))
cases.want:
import os
def f(n):
    return n
print(f(1))

cases.name: bottom inside a line is kept
